# Aggregate paper results (no item-level sealed rows)

These are the frozen headline numbers from the private scientific freeze
`7c4681eb2be52929793772a279a7a0fe4a3c85ee` ("Executable Evidence Contracts for
Signal-Grounded Verification of Wearable Sensor Claims", ICASSP 2027). They
are reported so the public tree can be read against the paper. They are
**not** regenerated by this repository's smoke tests; sealed item-level
prediction files are intentionally withheld (see `PUBLIC_PROVENANCE.md`).

Machine-readable aggregate stamps backing these numbers are included at
`reports/ICASSP_FINAL_10OF10_HARDENING/H4_PROPERTY_VALIDATION/h4_score_stamp.json`,
`.../H3_PHYSICAL_INTERVENTION/h3_score_stamp.json`,
`.../V2/H2B/h2b_official_analysis_stamp.json`, and the hash manifest at
`.../FINAL_SUBMISSION/result_manifest.json`. Run `python reproduce.py --tables`
to check these cells mechanically.

## E1 — DSP property validation (analytic identities, eight primitives)

- $9000/9000$ property tests pass; $0$ implementation bugs, $0$ specification ambiguities.
- Per-operator $n$: frequency $1400$, RMS $1200$, peak $800$, range $800$, trend $800$, periodicity $1000$, low-band energy $1200$, lag $1800$.

## E2 — Controlled physical interventions

- Threshold-crossing verdict fidelity (VFC): $771/771$ ($100\%$, Wilson $95\%$ $[0.995,1.000]$).
- Pooled directional match (DMC): $742/773 = 96.0\%$ $[0.944,0.972]$.
- Cross-channel lag is the identifiability boundary: all-case lag DMC $51/79$; no-coupling stratum $51/53$; lag VFC $77/77$.

## E3a — Frozen direct-template-family holdout (development-only thresholds)

- $828/828$ exact and verdict accuracy; FCR $0/92$. This cell does not test unseen linguistic realization.

## E3b — Sealed unseen-language holdout ("H2"; $448$ surfaces, $64$ unlicensed)

- Exact program $326/448 = 72.8\%$; verdict $395/448 = 88.2\%$; unlicensed FCR $16/64$.
- Retained as a permanent failure result, not superseded or relabeled as a pilot.

## E3c — Independent paired holdout ("H2B"; $192$ semantic programs, $768$ surfaces; base vs. deterministic-grounding compiler)

| Metric | Base (V1) | Grounded (V2) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Channel-grounding false certification (count) | $44$ | $0$ |
| Alternate-channel substitution (count) | $11$ | $0$ |
| Unlicensed FCR | $102/192\ (53.1\%)$ | $47/192\ (24.5\%)$ |
| Licensed verdict | $522/576\ (90.6\%)$ | $522/576\ (90.6\%)$ |
| Program exact | $73.3\%$ | $67.7\%$ |
| Overall verdict | $79.7\%$ | $86.8\%$ |

Deterministic source grounding eliminates the two *targeted* error classes
(channel-grounding, alternate substitution) without changing licensed-case
verdict accuracy; residual unlicensed FCR ($47/192$) remains, concentrated in
unit / sampling-rate / evidence-admissibility cases, and is **not** sufficient
for an unrestricted natural-language verification claim.

## Superseded / earlier-phase numbers (kept for continuity with prior public releases)

These were reported under an earlier framing of this project before the
evidence-contract / H2 / H2B experiments existed. They are not the paper's
headline cells and are retained only so earlier public-release consumers are
not left with a dangling reference.

- Controlled V3 (same-window thresholds; live gold): exact $94.3\%\ (2415/2562)$; verdict $99.5\%\ (2549/2562)$; FCR $0/126$; FA $11/2436$.
- Representation / resampling (unused PAMAP2, $n=32$): dominant-frequency verdict $100\%$ ($50$ Hz) vs. $90.6\%$ ($20$ Hz); low-band verdict $100\%$ / $100\%$; physical lag verdict $87.5\%$ / $65.6\%$; lag $\rho$ $0.75$ / $0.30$.
